customManagers.description: Engine pins: the tfpr uses: ref in every caller workflow
Provider constraints inside the Terragrunt generate blocks (root.hcl and unit overrides)

packageRules.description: Registry modules (AVM and Azure/naming): one pull request for every module bump
prBodyNotes: AVM modules can break on 0.x minors. Read each module's release notes and every unit's plan before applying. A module that needs a newer provider than a unit's lock file fails init: refresh that lock file with `terragrunt run -- providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` in this pull request.

packageRules.description: Provider constraints: a version outside the range is listed on the dashboard, with no pull request until approved there, because a new major needs the AVM modules to support it first
A minor or patch engine release: one pull request for all five callers
prBodyNotes: Read the engine release notes before merging.

packageRules.description: A major engine release, step 1: the ops and drift callers, because a dispatched run uses the ops caller on main
packageRules.groupName: tfpr engine major (1 of 2, ops and drift callers)
packageRules.commitMessageTopic: the tfpr engine ops and drift callers
prBodyNotes: Step 1 of 2 of a major engine bump. Read the release notes: a major can need caller edits beyond the version, and they go in this pull request. Merge this one first; step 2 moves the PR, unlock and review callers.

packageRules.description: A major engine release, step 2: the PR, unlock and review callers, after step 1 is on main
packageRules.groupName: tfpr engine major (2 of 2, PR, unlock and review callers)
packageRules.commitMessageTopic: the tfpr engine PR, unlock and review callers
prBodyNotes: Step 2 of 2 of a major engine bump. Merge step 1 (the ops and drift callers) first. Until it is on main, the pre-commit job here fails the engine pin check on purpose; Renovate rebases this branch once step 1 merges, and the check passes.
